indicator_name: Weekly prices of socially significant food products (2022-2025 basket, 19 items), KZT
description: Еженедельные цены на социально значимые продовольственные товары (корзина 2022-2025 гг., 19 товаров), тенге
unit: KZT per kg (per litre: milk, kefir, sunflower oil; eggs as the source gives them)
methodology: Taldau 703112, weekly period, the basket of 2022-2025: 207 weeks, 2022 week 2 to 2025 week 52, national average, dated each week's Wednesday. Closed history (refreshed once a year). Level breaks against the 2026 basket (SOCIAL_FOOD_PRICES_WEEKLY) from new product specifications: rice 384.54 to 552.69, buckwheat 251.36 to 409.11, eggs 5 594.60 to 560.43 (unit). Bread 160.58 (2022-w02) to 209.83 (2025-w52). No machine-readable weekly prices exist before 2022.
